definitions.explanation: Pain or discomfort in the joints, often caused by injury, arthritis, or other conditions.

examples.japanese: {寒|さむ}くなると{関節痛|かんせつつう}がひどくなる。
examples.english: Joint pain gets worse when it gets cold.

examples.japanese: {関節痛|かんせつつう}で{階段|かいだん}の{上|のぼ}り{下|お}りがつらい。
examples.english: Going up and down stairs is hard because of joint pain.

examples.japanese: {関節痛|かんせつつう}の{原因|げんいん}を{調|しら}べるために{検査|けんさ}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I had a test to find out the cause of my joint pain.

notes:
{関節痛|かんせつつう} is the medical term for joint pain.

WORD FORMATION:
{関節|かんせつ} (joint) + {痛|つう} (pain) = {関節痛|かんせつつう}

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {関節痛|かんせつつう}がある - to have joint pain
- {関節痛|かんせつつう}がひどい - joint pain is severe
- {関節痛|かんせつつう}を{和|やわ}らげる - to relieve joint pain

RELATED CONDITIONS:
- {関節炎|かんせつえん} - arthritis
- {関節|かんせつ}リウマチ - rheumatoid arthritis
- {変形|へんけい}{性|せい}{関節症|かんせつしょう} - osteoarthritis

OTHER PAIN TERMS:
- {頭痛|ずつう} - headache
- {腰痛|ようつう} - back pain
- {腹痛|ふくつう} - stomachache
